BiblicalUsage: Mene is the word of the writing on the wall, numbered. Daniel 5:25 gives the writing itself, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN, and Daniel 5:26 gives the reading: MENE, God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God numbers kingdoms the way He numbers days, and when the count is finished the kingdom is finished too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
